item.title: claude-mem: How It Works, Install, Cost and Limits
item.description:
claude-mem is an Apache 2.0 plugin that gives a coding agent memory of its own past sessions. Lifecycle hooks capture what the agent does, an LLM compresses that into observations and summaries, a local worker stores them in SQLite, and the next session starts with the relevant parts already in context.

It is one of the most starred agent memory projects on GitHub: 103,771 stars on 28 October 2026, from a repo created on 31 August 2025 by Alex Newman (@thedotmack). Every fact below comes from the claude-mem README and docs.claude-mem.ai, checked on 17 October 2026; the release changes through v15.4.0 come from the release notes, checked on 28 October 2026. For Claude Code’s own built-in memory, which is a separate thing, see Claude Code memory.
